name: schemo-extension
description: Schemo Bridge — browser extension that hands the requests of chosen tabs to the desktop app.

scripts.build: pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:firefox && pnpm build:edge
scripts.build:chrome: SCHEMO_TARGET=chrome parcel build --dist-dir dist/chrome --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/chrome
scripts.build:firefox: SCHEMO_TARGET=firefox parcel build --dist-dir dist/firefox --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/firefox
scripts.build:edge: SCHEMO_TARGET=edge parcel build --dist-dir dist/edge --no-source-maps --no-optimize && copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/edge
scripts.dev:chrome: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/chrome && SCHEMO_TARGET=chrome parcel watch --dist-dir dist/chrome --no-hmr
scripts.dev:firefox: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/firefox && SCHEMO_TARGET=firefox parcel watch --dist-dir dist/firefox --no-hmr
scripts.dev:edge: copyfiles -u 1 "public/**/*" dist/edge && SCHEMO_TARGET=edge parcel watch --dist-dir dist/edge --no-hmr
scripts.zip: pnpm build && pnpm zip:chrome && pnpm zip:firefox && pnpm zip:edge
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm lint:firefox
